claim: Excluding diabetes_mellitus, Train and Unlabeled share an identical 180-column predictor schema with >=3 structural drop columns and >=1 near-constant (>=99%).
Subtends #I1. DataDictionaryWiDS2021.csv has schema/metadata drift vs CSVs while hospital_id has zero overlap between Train and Unlabeled.
Excluding structural IDs, constants, and target, TrainingWiDS2021.csv has < 9 exact 175-col clinical duplicates, showing AutoViz's 9 duplicates came from column reduction.
Subtends #I2. Train contains >= 10 within-hospital demographic near-duplicate pairs (>=90% agreement) or >= 1 cross-split F_clinical collision with Unlabeled.
Subtends #I2. AutoViz's 9 flagged duplicates arise strictly after AutoViz caps predictors to <= 30 columns rather than existing as 9 excess copies in 175 cols.
Across 64 matched (h1_, d1_) pairs, h1_ features exhibit >= 5.0 pp higher median missingness than d1_ twins, concentrating >= 60% of >50%-missing cols in h1_/blood gas.
Subtends #I3. At least 10 predictors shift >= 5.0 pp in missingness between Train and Unlabeled or reach >= 95.0% null in UnlabeledWiDS2021.csv.
Across TrainingWiDS2021.csv and UnlabeledWiDS2021.csv, icu_id is recycled across distinct hospital_id values (>= 50% combined and > 0% within-train collisions).
Subtends #I4. 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold(groups=hospital_id) meets fold balance tolerances while icu_id target-encoding leaks under StratifiedKFold (>=0.55) and collapses under grouped CV (<0.52).
The 175 clinical predictors (F_clinical) exhibit material out-of-hospital covariate shift between Train and Unlabeled (grouped Adversarial AUC >= 0.65).
Subtends #I5. Adversarial discriminability is substantially driven by missingness-pattern shifts (bmi, weight, age) or icu_id collisions.

Diabetes prevalence (~21.63%) varies substantially across hospitals (IQR >= 4.0 pp, chi2 p < 0.001) and across >= 3 of 4 core strata (age_bin, ethnicity, icu_type, elective_surgery; p < 0.001 and range >= 3.0 pp).

Subtends #I6 and #I3.1. Missing strata in age/bmi/weight/ethnicity differ by >= 2.0 pp in diabetes prevalence (p < 0.01), and Train-to-Unlabeled composition shifts imply >= 0.50 pp projected target prior shift.
Rivals P1 ('All variables are non-linear distribution'). Fewer than 100% of continuous predictors (nunique>=10) violate normality, with >=10% near-Gaussian.
Subtends #I7. Non-linear grouped HGB AUC and MI surface predictive signals missed by Pearson |r| (Top-20 Jaccard < 0.80 and >= 5 numeric features with lift).
Within Top-25 predictors by grouped HGB AUC, |Spearman rho| >= 0.80 collapses the 25 features into <= 14 clusters with c_top1 having >= 1 Top-25 twin.
Subtends #I8 and rivals pre-assumptive low-R discard claim. Adding features ranked 26..175 increases 5-fold grouped HGB AUC by >= +0.015 (>= 4/5 folds).
Zero Top-40 features cross deterministic single-feature leakage (AUC >= 0.90), while >= 3 F_clinical columns contain hard physiological/unit impossible values.
Subtends #I9. At least 1 APACHE diagnosis code (n>=30) has >= 85% diabetes prevalence, and dropping glucose + diagnosis lowers grouped AUC by >= 0.04 while retaining non-glucose AUC >= 0.72.
Across deduplicated non-trivial missingness masks in F_clinical, missingness is MNAR/MAR wrt diabetes_mellitus (>= 10 masks with BH-FDR q < 0.01 & |Δ| >= 2.0 pp).
Subtends #I10. Explicit missingness flags/panel counts lift grouped HGB AUC by >= +0.005 over imputed without flags (or >= +0.002 over native NaN).
Across 64 min/max pairs, 64 (h1_, d1_) bounds, and BMI formula checks in Train and Test, >= 100 total structural violations or >= 1 min>max / h1>d1 violation occur.
Subtends #I11. General BP columns absorb >= 99% of invasive/noninvasive BP readings (unabsorbed <= 0.01%) and dropping sub-columns with has_invasive_bp preserves AUC.
Numeric predictors exhibit >= 5 dictionary unit-scale mismatches and >= 3 extreme tail columns (>= 0.1%), while sanitizing hard sentinels to NaN preserves AUC.
Subtends #I12. Zero-coded vital/age anomalies cluster inside specific hospital_id feeds (top-5 hospitals >= 50% of zeros or >= 25% rate in a hospital n >= 30).
Across the 8 realized WiDS 2021 categorical/diagnosis predictors, >= 50 rare levels (n < 30) and >= 1 unseen Unlabeled test category level exist.
Subtends #I13. Decomposing apache_3j_diagnosis into hierarchical nominal parts + OOF smoothed TE lifts diagnosis-only AUC >= +0.010 and full AUC >= +0.001.
Across 16 tri-window analytes, median |Spearman rho(d1_max, apache)| >= 0.75, yet dropping h1_ or 15 _apache twins reduces 5-fold SGKF AUC by >= 0.001.
Subtends #I14 and tests AutoViz SULO pruning. Greedy correlation pruning at |rho| >= 0.80 degrades 5-fold SGKF HGB AUC by >= 0.002.
Across Top-25 + clinical watchlist predictors, zero originate post-24h or hit AUC >= 0.90, and all predictors with AUC >= 0.55 generalize cleanly across folds.
Subtends #I15. Early ICU-door + 1h predictors achieve SGKF AUC >= 0.78, and adding 28 T3_apache summary covariates on top of 24h vitals/labs adds < 0.015.
Cumulative clean domain FE (Families A-D: cleaning, glycemic dynamics, clinical ratios, APACHE3j hierarchy+TE+panel miss) lifts SGKF AUC >= +0.0030 (>=4/5 folds) and cuts Log-Loss >= 0.0010.
Subtends #I16. Fold-safe clinical-stratum z-scores (age_bin x icu_type) or unsupervised within-hospital covariate centering lifts eng_AD SGKF AUC >= +0.0015.
Random 5-fold StratifiedKFold artificially inflates fe_ABCD ROC-AUC vs. StratifiedGroupKFold(groups=hospital_id) by >= +0.0040 with facility IDs and >= +0.0015 even after dropping IDs.
Subtends #I17 and #I7.1. Under 5-fold SGKF, non-linear fe_ABCD HGB outperforms preprocessed LogisticRegression by >= +0.0250 AUC while LogReg hits >= 0.7800.

Under 5-fold SGKF, cleaned+engineered Model B outperforms Raw Model A across ROC-AUC (>=+0.0030), PR-AUC (>=+0.0040), Log-Loss (>=-0.0030), Brier (>=-0.0005), ECE_10 <= 0.0150, and dedup |ΔAUC| < 0.0010.
